companies.name: Acme Foods
companies.description: Wholesale food distributor running 12 depots around Columbus, Ohio, with ~600 hourly drivers, pickers and loaders. Schedules live in one Excel workbook per depot; overtime is up 18% YoY (~14% of paid hours) and early-shift no-shows run ~7%.

companies.name: Northgate Logistics
companies.description: Third-party warehousing and fulfillment provider with 20 warehouses across Indiana running 24/7. Rotas are rebuilt weekly in Google Sheets per site; overtime is ~16% of hours and night-shift no-shows ~9%, with Q4 peak doubling volume.

companies.name: Harbor Health
companies.description: Group of 8 walk-in urgent care clinics in greater Milwaukee where every shift needs the right credential mix. Signed Shiftpoint Pro 8 on 2026-10-28; onboarding with Marco Rossi starts Nov 17 and Customer Success (Erin Walsh) owns the relationship.

companies.name: Bluepeak Fitness
companies.description: Chain of 15 24-hour gyms across both Kansas City metros with ~420 part-time staff. Chose Crewlane over Shiftpoint on price in June 2026 (Closed Lost); Regional Manager Chris Yoon is re-opening the conversation because Crewlane adoption is poor. GM Lena Ortiz is do-not-contact.

companies.name: Copper Kettle Restaurant Group
companies.description: Restaurant group with 9 casual-dining restaurants and brunch cafés in Minneapolis/St. Paul. Uses a free scheduling app at some sites and paper plus group chat at others; weekend brunch no-shows run ~8% and they want one system before spring patio season.

companies.name: Lakeshore Hotels
companies.description: Group of 6 upscale select-service hotels in Chicago and the North Shore. Each department keeps its own spreadsheet; housekeeping overtime hits ~12% on busy weekends and they want labor to follow occupancy. Fully on 2026 pricing after the September price-list correction.

companies.name: Pine & Pebble Home
companies.description: Design-led home-goods retailer with 25 stores across Colorado, Utah and New Mexico and ~700 hourly staff. Their POS scheduling module can't handle swaps or forecasting, so they are evaluating Pro for labor forecasting, compliance and payroll export. Referred by Summit Brew.

companies.name: SparklePro Cleaning
companies.description: Commercial cleaning company with 14 branches in Nebraska, Iowa and Kansas dispatching ~650 night-shift cleaners to ~400 client buildings. ~6% of shifts go uncovered and missed cleans cost ~$90k in client credits last year; the COO wants GPS clock-in and open-shift pickup.

companies.name: Ironclad Guard Services
companies.description: Contract security firm staffing 30 client sites 24/7 around Phoenix and Tucson with ~520 licensed officers. HQ dispatch builds one big spreadsheet; overtime is ~19% of hours and ~4% of shifts are call-outs filled by phone.

companies.name: Little Acorns Childcare
companies.description: Nonprofit-backed group of 11 childcare centers along the Front Range with strict staff-to-child ratio rules. Directors schedule on paper grids (~6h/week each) and floaters are coordinated by text; the board approves spend over $25k.

companies.name: Mesa Valley Urgent Care
companies.description: Five urgent care clinics in Albuquerque and Rio Rancho with ~140 hourly staff. Clinic Manager Nora Kim builds every rota in a shared Google Sheet (~8h/week); brand-new inbound lead from Nov 7 via the Harbor Health case study.

companies.name: Summit Brew Co.
companies.description: Craft brewery with 7 taprooms in Northern Colorado; Shiftpoint Core customer since Feb 2024 and a public reference. Existing 7 locations are on 2025 pricing ($135) until renewal 2027-02-01; adding 3 taprooms (Windsor, Estes Park, Greeley Downtown) Dec 2026 – Mar 2027.

companies.name: Crewlane
companies.description: Direct competitor selling shift-scheduling software at roughly $110–125 per location per month, aggressive in logistics. Won Bluepeak Fitness on price in June 2026 and is competing on Northgate Logistics. Not a prospect; known to fish for Shiftpoint pricing.

companies.name: Acme Food Group
companies.description: Restaurant supply company in Dayton, Ohio, running 4 warehouses. Evaluated Shiftpoint Core for its 4 warehouses in May 2026 and went Closed Lost (no budget). NOT related to Acme Foods (acmefoods.com, Columbus) despite the similar name.
